ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels constitute approximately 15-20% of the visible surface, localized primarily at the left lobe tip, while low-intensity dark pixels cover the remaining 80-85% of the fluke body.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white blob located at the distal-lateral terminus of the left lobe; dominant low-intensity dark field across the central fluke and right lobe, punctuated by sparse, high-frequency white speckling.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression with an estimated 45-degree angle in 2D projection, characterized by high pixel depth relative to the horizontal lobe axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the right lobe trailing edge with pixel amplitudes between 5 and 15 pixels; trailing edge of the left lobe is obscured/modified by biological cluster topography.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve fitted to the trailing edge of the right lobe; left lobe tip exhibits a localized convex curvature at the outer margin.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast cluster of circular white textured pixel groups (barnacle colonization) localized on the distal end of the left lobe; secondary scattered white punctate spots on the central dark surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive biological encrustation on the left fluke tip creating a significantly thickened and irregular 2D profile.
other_distinctive_markers: Deep, non-uniform jagged indentation (notch) located on the medial-inner section of the right lobe trailing edge.
